title: [2026 Hardening] Correct crate repository metadata and package links
objective: Replace placeholder repository metadata and validate all published package links.

title: [2026 Hardening] Enforce the Rust 1.80 MSRV in CI
objective: Declare, test, and document the minimum supported Rust version.

title: [2026 Quality] Replace crate-wide lint allowances with scoped exceptions
objective: Restore useful compiler and Clippy signals while documenting necessary local exceptions.

title: [2026 Supply Chain] Add cargo-audit to pull-request and scheduled CI
objective: Detect vulnerable Rust dependencies with an explicit triage and exemption workflow.

title: [2026 Supply Chain] Enforce license and source policy with cargo-deny
objective: Check licenses, advisories, duplicate crates, and allowed registries on every change.

title: [2026 Build] Verify Cargo.lock reproducibility on all supported platforms
objective: Ensure locked builds do not mutate dependency resolution on Linux, macOS, or Windows.

title: [2026 Build] Add first-class Windows and macOS CLI test jobs
target: GitHub Actions and CLI integration tests
objective: Exercise filesystem, process, terminal, and path behavior on all supported operating systems.

title: [2026 Release] Test the installer in disposable environments
objective: Verify clean install, upgrade, checksum failure, unsupported platform, and uninstall guidance.

title: [2026 Release] Sign release artifacts and publish checksums
objective: Provide verifiable provenance and checksums for every distributed binary and archive.

title: [2026 Release] Automate Homebrew formula updates from tagged releases
objective: Update versions, URLs, checksums, and smoke tests without manual formula edits.

title: [2026 Config] Make configuration writes atomic and crash-safe
objective: Use same-directory temporary files, fsync where appropriate, and atomic replacement.

title: [2026 Config] Add explicit configuration schema migrations
objective: Upgrade older config files predictably with backups and actionable migration errors.

title: [2026 Security] Enforce private permissions on secret-bearing files
objective: Create and repair sensitive files with least-privilege permissions across supported platforms.

title: [2026 Security] Zeroize secret material after use
objective: Minimize lifetime and accidental copies of seed phrases, passphrases, and secret keys in memory.

title: [2026 Security] Centralize secret redaction for logs and errors
objective: Prevent keys, mnemonics, tokens, and signed transactions from appearing in terminal or structured logs.

title: [2026 Wallet] Version and tune password-based encryption parameters
objective: Store KDF metadata per wallet and support safe parameter upgrades without data loss.

title: [2026 Wallet] Define a versioned, authenticated backup format
objective: Support integrity checking, migration, and clear compatibility guarantees for backups.

title: [2026 Wallet] Exercise hardware-wallet builds and mocks in CI
objective: Compile optional backends and test device approval, rejection, disconnect, and unsupported envelopes.

title: [2026 Network] Apply bounded retries and timeouts to Horizon calls
objective: Use consistent timeout, backoff, retry classification, and user-facing failure messages.

title: [2026 Network] Validate custom network URLs and passphrases
objective: Reject unsafe or malformed endpoints and require explicit confirmation for passphrase changes.

title: [2026 Network] Prevent Friendbot use outside test networks
objective: Gate Friendbot by verified network identity rather than display name alone.

title: [2026 Network] Add machine-readable network health output
objective: Report endpoint latency, ledger freshness, protocol version, and failure details in JSON and text.

title: [2026 CLI] Add a global stable JSON output contract
objective: Provide versioned machine-readable success and error envelopes across commands.

title: [2026 CLI] Standardize documented exit codes
target: main command dispatch and error types
objective: Map usage, configuration, network, signing, and execution failures to stable exit codes.

title: [2026 CLI] Add a non-interactive mode for automation
target: global CLI arguments and prompting helpers
objective: Fail clearly instead of prompting and accept secure input alternatives in CI.

title: [2026 CLI] Snapshot-test shell completions for every command
objective: Detect missing flags, stale descriptions, and shell-specific regressions.

title: [2026 Documentation] Generate and package man pages
target: Clap command metadata and release packaging
objective: Ship searchable manual pages that stay synchronized with CLI help.

title: [2026 Privacy] Make telemetry opt-in and auditable
objective: Default to no collection, show the exact payload, and support complete local reset.

title: [2026 Plugins] Version the plugin ABI and negotiate compatibility
objective: Reject incompatible plugins safely and publish a supported-version policy.

title: [2026 Plugins] Verify plugin signatures and trust metadata
objective: Authenticate plugin publishers and surface verification status before installation or execution.

title: [2026 Plugins] Enforce plugin filesystem and network capabilities
objective: Require explicit capabilities and deny undeclared access at runtime.

title: [2026 Plugins] Isolate plugin crashes from the host CLI
objective: Contain panics and abnormal exits while returning diagnostics without corrupting state.

title: [2026 Registry] Add cursor pagination and cache validators
objective: Scale template browsing with stable cursors, ETags, and conditional requests.

title: [2026 Registry] Verify downloaded template checksums
objective: Reject tampered or incomplete archives before extraction or scaffolding.

title: [2026 Registry] Add authentication and abuse controls to publish APIs
objective: Authenticate publishers, rate-limit mutations, and retain auditable ownership history.

title: [2026 Templates] Prevent archive path traversal during extraction
objective: Reject absolute paths, parent traversal, links, and files outside the destination root.

title: [2026 Templates] Make scaffolding output deterministic
objective: Produce identical files for identical inputs with stable ordering and timestamps.

title: [2026 Templates] Validate templates against the registry schema before use
objective: Fail early with field-level errors for malformed local or marketplace templates.

title: [2026 Deployment] Make deployment operations idempotent and resumable
objective: Persist checkpoints and safely resume after interruption without duplicating successful steps.

title: [2026 Deployment] Add a deterministic dry-run deployment plan
objective: Show network, account, code hash, fees, authorization, and exact planned mutations without submitting.

title: [2026 Soroban] Poll transaction status to a terminal result

title: [2026 Soroban] Include simulation resource fees in transaction planning
objective: Use simulation output to report CPU, memory, footprint, and minimum resource fee.

title: [2026 Multisig] Validate thresholds and signer weights before export

objective: Reject oversized or policy-violating modules before network submission.

objective: Tie retries, network requests, plugin calls, and deployment steps to one invocation without leaking secrets.

title: [2026 Storage] Introduce transactional database migrations

objective: Preserve valid values and reject malformed combinations across generated inputs.

title: [2026 Testing] Fuzz wallet import and backup parsers
objective: Cover malformed JSON, truncated ciphertext, invalid StrKeys, oversized inputs, and Unicode edge cases.

objective: Track representative cold-start and command paths and flag statistically meaningful regressions.
